name: Pipeliners - OTTO Meta Keywords Inventory 2026-08-19
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-08-19

# Summary
Data exports from the Aug 18-19 OTTO meta-keyword work, folded into one note:
- `otto-meta-keywords-full-inventory.csv`: 157 OTTO URLs classified against WordPress post type (55 posts, 48 pages, 19 category archives, 14 date archives, 7 author archives, 6 blog index, 5 tag archives, 2 system templates, home). 105 had meta keywords, 52 were missing. Actions: 105 Done, 24 "Generate + deploy", 28 skipped as archives or templates.
- `otto-missing-meta-keywords.csv`: the 52 missing rows.
- `pipeliners-meta-keywords-2026-08-19.csv`: proposed primary keyword and meta keyword sets for 24 URLs (for example /free-sewer-inspection/ "free sewer camera inspection Phoenix", leak detection "leak detection Phoenix AZ", backwater valve post "backwater valve").
- `pipeliners-tracker-update-2026-08-19.tsv`: the same 24 rows with deployed status ("Done 8/19/26" and notes).

# Context
Per the handoff, Kim first said not to deploy meta keywords, then approved; 24 keyword sets were deployed in OTTO on Aug 18-19. Meta keywords carry little ranking weight; the work mainly cleaned up OTTO's own targeting (for example, junk terms on Buckeye).
